effects.label: Burn
effects.description: Damages the recipient by a percentage of their MAX HP, once per tick, for the duration of the debuff. Creates a Damage Zone around the recipient, damaging any of their allies in the indicated radius by a percentage of their MAX HP every tick.The number of ticks per second increases with Skill Speed. This debuff can be stacked.

bio: The perfect marriage of Memorium and metal, Ferrogar is a marvel of Stoneheart engineering. Deepcast Dwarves argue that Ferrogar is theirs, due to its deep iron drill that can smash through any surface. The Goldcast says that its gold accents and glowing furnace make it their property. Ferrogar cares not for petty squabbles. It only has one directive – drill.
